ShortDescription.Value: Show/hide notification clutter with a Mini HUD, instant icon controls, road labels/arrows, Money+Population trends, extra city stats.

Publish.LongDescription:
### City Watchdog
Clean up notification clutter and keep your city easier to read while you build.
#### Main features - **Mini HUD** — track the notification problems you care about and click an alert to jump through problem locations. - **Show All / Hide All** — instantly show or hide normal map notification icons. - **Presets 1 | 2** — save two custom notification checkbox layouts. - **Road controls** — show/hide road names, district names, and 1-way road arrows. - **[i] button** — instantly show/hide vanilla mouse-over tooltips. - **Bigger UI** — quick access to the game's interface scaling without launching Developer Mode. - **Extra city info** — useful money trends and additional population stats.
City Watchdog helps you see and manage city information — it does not fix city problems for you.
#### Good to know - Blue Stars are Mini HUD favorites and are separate from Presets 1 | 2. - Open the main panel from the top-left paw icon. - Safe for city saves and safe to remove. No Harmony patches.
### Support and feedback If City Watchdog helps you, clicking LIKE makes it easier for other players to find.
Feedback is welcome through the GitHub or Discord buttons on the right.
### Thanks - River Mochi - main author - yenyang - locale tech feedback - Notices inspired by the original City Controller by Mbyron26 - Money View inspired by earlier Show Text by DanielNZ - Dorkington - tester/feature suggestion - Nukprach, Dataknase, Brainium, Flightech, SonNathan - testers - UnMaestro - testing, German editor - gagaxm - testing, French editor - Obelix - testing, Portuguese editor
Thumbnail photograph by Maryia Shedava at Mont Saint-Michel in Normandy, France: https://unsplash.com/photos/a-dog-poses-in-front-of-a-distant-castle-bEpjaU_CTcM
**15 languages supported:** English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Português Portugal, ไทย, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文.

Publish.ChangeLog: - City Watchdog is now focused on notifications, visual comfort, Mini HUD, tooltips, and extra city information. - Budget/Milestone tools moved to the new Budget + Milestones mod. - Added Bigger UI button — quick access to the game's own interface scaling [x] toggle (without need for Developer Mode). - Added Presets 1 | 2 — hold to save and click to load two notification checkbox layouts. Blue Stars remain separate Mini HUD favorites. - Whole notification rows can now be clicked to jump to the problem location. - Population tooltip now includes unemployment plus homeless count and rate. - Improved collapsed-panel sorting and updated defaults: 80% panel opacity, horizontal Mini HUD, and Monthly Money Trends.
